selection.scope: One formal decode down-projection shape only; the optional gate/up shape is not scheduled in OPE3.

four_questions.authenticity: PASS: the operation, M/K/N geometry, and frequency are frozen in the E4B census and OPE1 manifest; CPU execution is a cross-ISA instrument, not the RKLLM deployment path.
four_questions.bottleneck: PASS: M=1 int8 GEMV has 1.998438719750 ops/analytic-byte and is expected to be memory-bound against the OPE0 board ceiling.
four_questions.capability: PASS: the measured A76 feature set contains asimddp; the candidate uses ARMv8.2 dot-product intrinsics and does not require i8mm, SVE, or SME.
four_questions.deliverability: PASS: the row has an exact OPE2 int8 primitive anchor, a lineage-separated sm_89 NF4 reference, and an explicit future OPE4 stage anchor.

ope0_bandwidth_ceiling.evidence_limit: One formal OPE0 segment; the owner waived the second segment, so this denominator is not replicated evidence.

semantic_contract.operation: For n in [0,N), Y[n] = sum over k in [0,K) of int32(X[k]) * int32(W[n,K+k]).
semantic_contract.weight_storage: row-major contiguous [N,K], one output row per contiguous K-byte span
semantic_contract.overflow_contract: Frozen correctness distributions keep every exact sum inside signed int32; overflow behavior is not part of the contract.
semantic_contract.oracle: Scalar C accumulation in int32 with vectorization disabled; every output element must match exactly.

candidate.identity_policy: The source hash is checked in every formal segment. Any source change requires a transparently versioned preregistration before new formal data.

scalar.role: exact oracle and timed scalar baseline
scalar.implementation: plain C inner product compiled at -O3 with function-scoped vectorization disabled
scalar.required_assembly_property: no NEON dot-product instruction in the scalar kernel

autovec.implementation: the same plain C inner-product semantics compiled with -O3 -mcpu=cortex-a76 and normal GCC auto-vectorization
autovec.required_build_evidence: retain GCC vectorization diagnostics and disassembly

neon_sdot.implementation: ARM NEON signed-dot intrinsics with independent accumulators and exact int32 reduction

correctness_protocol.coverage: All 2,560 outputs for autovec and neon_sdot are compared with the scalar oracle in every trial.
correctness_protocol.pass_rule: All 15,360 candidate/baseline output comparisons are exact and all output checksums are emitted.
correctness_protocol.repair_kill: After three candidate correctness repair iterations, stop OPE3 and retain the failing cases. Harness-only defects may be fixed with an explicit attempt record.

measurement_protocol.thread_pinning: OpenMP worker tid i is pinned to cpu 4+i; the controller also uses taskset -c 4-7.
measurement_protocol.interleave: Six fixed permutations of scalar/autovec/neon_sdot repeat round-robin so each variant occupies every order slot.
measurement_protocol.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW around one full four-thread GEMV invocation
measurement_protocol.frequency_gate: Every timed-window policy4 and policy6 frequency sample must be at least 95% of its recorded max.
measurement_protocol.thermal_gate: No timed-window thermal sample may equal or exceed the lowest enabled trip point recorded for its zone.
measurement_protocol.stability_gate: If any variant has IQR/p50 > 0.30, discard that segment and repeat it once unchanged; a second unstable segment closes that segment as invalid.
measurement_protocol.replication_gate: Both valid segments must have the same candidate-vs-autovec direction and their candidate p50 relative difference must be <= 0.10.
measurement_protocol.controller_clock: Record controller wall-clock timestamps immediately before and after each board run; use board monotonic time for durations.
measurement_protocol.smoke_policy: No separate performance smoke is scheduled. The exact randomized correctness gate is the only pre-formal execution check.

tier_a.interpretation: Analytic unique-byte roofline score; it does not assert that every counted byte reached DRAM.

tier_b.scope: Run once after the first valid formal segment for all three variants; perf record is required only for neon_sdot.
tier_b.counter_policy: Attempt the frozen event group first. If parsing or support fails, isolate each event once and mark only unsupported events N/A; do not substitute unnamed raw events.
tier_b.analytic_backing_gate: Report the ratio of bus_access proxy bytes to total_unique_bytes * perf repetitions. A ratio within [0.80,1.20] is supporting evidence; a miss is retained and investigated, not normalized away.

npu_primitive.lineage: OPE2 rknn_matmul_run, int8xint8_to_int32, core0, normal layout

pc_sm89_reference.lineage: K2-R2 bitsandbytes 0.50.0 fused NF4 eager on RTX 4060 Laptop / sm_89; different dtype, packing, runtime, and byte model
pc_sm89_reference.use: Context-only third column. It must not be ranked against the NEON or NPU rows as an implementation win/loss.

ope4_anchor.current_disposition: OPE3 may close its isolated measurement and three-horizontal row, but final stage anchoring remains explicitly pending until OPE4.

outcome_rules.ope3_measurement_pass: Correctness, all three timed baselines, Tier-A, supported Tier-B counters, telemetry, paired governor restore, and two-segment replication gates pass.
outcome_rules.candidate_negative_rule: If neon_sdot is more than 30% slower than autovec and perf shows no bandwidth or stall headroom explanation, record a valid optimization-negative result; do not tune after observing formal data.
outcome_rules.success_definition: Gate closure and accurate reporting, not beating autovec, the NPU primitive, or the sm_89 reference.
outcome_rules.time_kill: Stop and write a bounded result if OPE3 exceeds four working days.

claim_limits: The CPU kernel is a cross-ISA instrument and is not used by the closed RKLLM deployment path; no board-model speedup may be claimed.
The OPE2 value is an isolated NPU primitive result, not RKLLM TPOT.
The PC row uses NF4 on sm_89 and is lineage-separated; it is context, not a same-format hardware contest.
The OPE4 model-stage anchor is pending and must not be fabricated from isolated OPE2/OPE3 timings.
All Tier-A scores inherit the single-segment owner-waiver evidence level of the OPE0 denominator.
No 3-core LLM, driver, device-tree, kernel, shared-library, quality-evaluation, or frozen model artifact change is authorized by this preregistration.
